obligationsRepaired: PAGE_ORDER — the packet is assembled in its committed packet-set manifest's component order. It ran 1000EX pp1-2, 1020EX pp3-5, 1044XX pp6-7, 1146XX p8, 1148XX pp9-10, 1149XX pp11-13, 1169XX pp14-16, BCI application pp17-18, release p19, with the prerequisite agency stage last and the petition and order before the cover sheet. It now runs BCI application pp1-2, release p3, 1044XX pp4-5, 1000EX pp6-7, 1020EX pp8-10, 1146XX p11, 1148XX pp12-13, 1149XX pp14-16, 1169XX pp17-19.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP — all nine selection marks are centred in their printed bracket pairs' measured interior gaps rather than drawn on top of the left bracket at its x-origin plus 1.5pt. The verdict scored this obligation PASS at its own base on a 100-dpi read that looked for words outside page boxes; measured here as ink at 1200 dpi, every one of the nine marks rendered as a single fused run with its bracket before the repair and as three separate runs after it.

SERVICE — the committed track registry's rule is stated: the court sends the filing to the prosecuting attorney and the petitioner does not effect service in the ordinary case, with the Proof of Service form as the optional form the registry describes. The instruction to mail or email the prosecutor and the service method, address and date prompts are removed from the prose and from the before-filing list. The verdict scored this obligation PASS at its own base by reading the held BCI handout as governing over the registry; this lane was assigned the registry's rule and applied it, and that disagreement is named here rather than buried.
obligationsThisRowDoesNotDischarge: FILING_DESTINATION. markMeasurement.howMeasured: Each printed bracket pair was rendered from the pinned source binary at 1200 dpi, cropped to the control's own y-band, and its ink columns read. The left bracket run, the interior gap and the right bracket run are measured ink, not glyph advance widths: on 1044XX page 2 the text stream reports '[' at x=355.98 and ']' at x=361.455 with advance widths near zero, while the ink is at 356.64-358.62 and 364.44-366.42, because the brackets are positioned by TJ offsets the advances do not describe.
markMeasurement.before: Each X was drawn at the printed left bracket's own x-origin plus 1.50pt, at a size of min(10, boxHeight-2), and printed on top of that bracket. Measured on the committed fixtures at 1200 dpi, every mark rendered as a single fused ink run with the bracket rather than as two runs.
markMeasurement.after: Each X is centred in the measured interior gap, shrunk in 0.25pt steps until it clears the gap by at least 0.5pt total, and the committed write box IS that gap rather than the bracket glyph.
markMeasurement.verifiedOnTheDeliveredBytes: Every mark on both fixtures of all four families was re-rendered at 1200 dpi and read as three separate ink runs (left bracket, X, right bracket). Minimum clearance measured anywhere is 0.30pt on the left and 0.42pt on the right; every mark's ink is inside its own committed write box. Before the repair the same measurement on the committed fixtures returned one fused run for every mark.
